title: Going Beneath the Surface: Evaluating Image Captioning for Grammaticality, Truthfulness and Diversity
answer_short: Diversity is measured as the ratio of observed number versus optimal number of language constructions used in captions.
answer_rationale: The diversity measurement is explicitly defined in block 7 as computing the ratio of observed number versus optimal number of language constructions, which are reduced representations capturing object descriptions by shape, color, or color-shape combinations.
